verdict.rationale: Restate documents durable timers for sleeping, scheduling and waiting on external events (restate-docs-5, restate-docs-29). It also says it suspends handlers while they sleep to free up resources and suspends idle long-running agents to save costs (restate-docs-21, restate-docs-36), and its invocations list shows suspended invocations (restate-docs-65). Waits for human approval survive restarts and infrastructure changes (restate-docs-48). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-day-to-month wait durations, documented release of connections and compute on non-FaaS (container/VM) deployments rather than only on platforms like Lambda, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
